subject.title: feat: publish integrations and Crabbox Agent Skill discovery

question: Should `crabbox init --skill` remain backward-compatible with arbitrary user-selected output paths, or should Crabbox intentionally require the new `crabbox/SKILL.md` layout as a breaking contract?
rationale: The branch changes an established configurable CLI path into a format-specific restriction; tests can verify either policy, but cannot decide which upgrade contract Crabbox should promise.

options.title: Preserve custom destinations
options.body: Keep accepting existing relative `--skill` paths and apply the strict standard-layout validation only to new opt-in or documented standard destinations.

options.title: Adopt the strict layout
options.body: Keep the new requirement, document it as an intentional compatibility break, provide an upgrade path, and add regression coverage for prior custom-path users.

recommendation.title: Preserve custom destinations
recommendation.body: Keep accepting existing relative `--skill` paths and apply the strict standard-layout validation only to new opt-in or documented standard destinations.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest hardening commit covers the exact integration-discovery contract that needs a direction decision.
